paras: Trachylepis raymondlaurenti, also known commonly as Laurent's long-tailed skink, is a species of lizard in the family Scincidae. The species is endemic to Africa.
The specific name, raymondlaurenti, is in honor of Belgian herpetologist Raymond Ferdinand Laurent.
T. raymondlaurenti is found in Angola,  Democratic Republic of the Congo, and Zambia.
Medium-sized for its genus, T. raymondlaurenti may attain a snout-to-vent length (SVL) of almost 8 cm (3.1 in). The tail is very long, more than twice SVL.
The mode of reproduction of T. raymondlaurenti is unknown.
